_comment: Kilo node registry template. Copy to ~/.config/meshforge/kilo_nodes.json and replace the SYNTHETIC anchors with your real lab nodes (MF014: no operator values in the repo copy). Anchors are RADIO identities — never IP addresses (DHCP reassigns them; the loader refuses IP-shaped anchors loudly). Roles: esp32-sensor | nrf-meshtastic | rnode | claw | gateway | other. cadence_s = the node's own telemetry period; status reads DARK after 3 missed cadences. Metric vocabulary (kilo/ingest.py NODE_METRICS): temperature humidity pressure gas_resistance co2 iaq pm25_standard pm10_standard voltage battery_level channel_utilization air_util_tx. Do NOT expect snr/rssi as node metrics — MQTT snr/rssi describe the last hop into the UPLINKING GATEWAY, not the node; per-link RF truth is the edges table (kilo matrix). Nodes whose anchors have no ingest adapter yet (rns) are reported UNKNOWN — declared, visible, never falsely OK or DARK. For a claw WITH a BLE half, also declare ble_advs/ble_adv_age_s so a dead BLE leg surfaces as DEGRADED instead of reading OK forever.
